OPEN SOURCE E-READER

Books first.
Everything else second.

ENKU is a compact open-source e-reader built around a Waveshare 3.97″ e-paper platform and readily available components. It is designed to be read, modified and built in the open.

ABOUT

What is ENKU?

A pocket-sized e-reader for people who love books and open projects. ENKU combines an accessible ESP32-S3 e-paper platform, a printable enclosure and open-source software. Read it, modify it, improve it and build it yourself.

Learn more about the project →

Open for contributions and ideas.

HARDWARE

Built from accessible parts.

ENKU starts with the Waveshare ESP32-S3 3.97″ e-paper development board. The goal is simple: use readily available components, avoid a custom PCB in the first version and keep the build reproducible.

SOFTWARE & UI

Designed around E Ink.

The interface is built for a small monochrome screen and physical navigation. Clear hierarchy, restrained controls and deliberate refreshes keep reading quiet and predictable.

Noto SansUI typography
800 × 480Native layout

DESIGN

Simple by intent.

The interface, enclosure and documentation follow the same idea: remove unnecessary layers, keep every control understandable and make the project easy to inspect.

01E Ink first

Layouts are designed around monochrome refresh behavior.

02Physical input

No touchscreen is required for core navigation.

03Printable enclosure

The case is intended to be reproduced on a consumer 3D printer.

BUILD ENKU
